title: Expose planning report CLI and renderers
description: Implement wtp planning report with optional --status and the six shared grouping flags. Human output renders a readable project/version/milestone tree with totals and aligned toplan/researched/planned/rejected counts, displaying empty grouping values as (unset). Root --json returns the typed nested report without chart or stats compatibility aliases. Validate arbitrary flag order, duplicates, empty selectors, unsupported statuses, zero-result reports, combined filters, lexical ordering, and stdout purity. Update immediate command registration/help stubs only; comprehensive documentation remains separate.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Starting CLI exposure and renderer work on the already-implemented planning report aggregation. I will preserve unrelated dirty changes, cover parser/rendering/filter/error/stdout contracts, then run focused and full verification before completion.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Implementation complete: registered planning report, added optional planning status and all six shared grouping selectors with duplicate/empty/unsupported validation, emitted typed nested planning.Report JSON, and added deterministic human project/version/milestone rendering with aligned toplan/researched/planned/rejected columns and (unset) values. Focused/full tests, race tests, vet, formatting, diff check, help, and zero-result CLI exercise passed.
